notReproduced.name: "__Host-" with an empty Path attribute is not set
notReproduced.why: Section 5.6.4 turns an empty Path value into the default path, which is / for a document at /, and section 5.7 step 21 asks only that a Path attribute is present and the cookie path is /. The file expects the cookie to be refused; the draft text accepts it.

notReproduced.name: "__Host-" with a valueless Path attribute is not set
notReproduced.why: A Path attribute with no value is read as an empty value (section 5.6 step 4), so the same reading applies as for an empty Path: the draft accepts it, the file refuses it.

notReproduced.name: __Http: Does not set via HTTP with Path=/ (without Secure)
notReproduced.why: The __Http- prefix is not in draft-ietf-httpbis-rfc6265bis-22 (a search of the text finds no such prefix), so the page does not enforce it.

notReproduced.name: __Http: Does not set via HTTP with 'Secure; Path=/'
notReproduced.why: The __Http- prefix is not in draft-ietf-httpbis-rfc6265bis-22, so the page does not enforce its HttpOnly requirement.

notReproduced.name: __Host-Http: Does not set via HTTP with 'Secure; Path=/'
notReproduced.why: The __Host-Http- prefix is not in draft-ietf-httpbis-rfc6265bis-22; the draft reads the name as an ordinary name that starts with __Host-, which this cookie satisfies.

notReproduced.name: __Host-Http: Does not set via HTTP with 'Path=/' (without Secure)
notReproduced.why: Not a disagreement about the outcome: the cookie is refused here too, because it starts with __Host- and has no Secure attribute. It is listed because the file expects the refusal for the __Host-Http- rule, which the draft does not have.
